description:
🎨 Kids Pixel Art Coloring & Puzzle Games – Fun Learning for Toddlers & Preschool Kids

Kids Pixel Art Coloring & Puzzle Games is a fun and educational kids game designed for toddlers, babies, and preschool kids aged 3, 4, and 5. This all-in-one learning app combines pixel art coloring for kids, color by number for kids, paint by number activities, tangram puzzles for kids, and creative pattern challenges to make early learning fun through play.

Designed especially for young children, this kid-friendly app helps kids learn colors, numbers, shapes, patterns, matching, logic, and problem-solving in a playful and safe environment. Whether your child is filling pixel grids, solving tangram puzzles, or copying colorful pictures, every activity supports preschool learning, creativity, and fine motor development.

🧠 3 Fun Learning Games in 1 App
1. Pixel Art Ditto

Match and copy the picture using colorful blocks. This fun pixel puzzle mode helps children improve visual skills, attention, and pattern recognition.

2. Pixel Art Coloring

Enjoy pixel coloring for kids with cute pictures and simple grids. Kids can fill each image using bright colors and enjoy an easy color by number for kids experience.

3. Tangram Puzzle Game

Solve fun tangram puzzles for kids by fitting geometric shapes into outlines. Discover animals, vehicles, rockets, and many more exciting designs while building shape recognition and logic skills.

👶 Perfect for Toddlers, Babies & Preschool Kids

Learn colors, shapes, numbers, patterns, and logic
Easy drag-and-drop gameplay made for little hands
Great for toddlers aged 3-5 and preschool children
No reading required – just tap, drag, match, and play
Supports fine motor skills, focus, creativity, and hand-eye coordination
Encourages visual learning and early problem-solving
Simple, child-friendly activities with positive feedback
